description.en: >  This parameter is not publicly available.

description.zh: 升级版本说明的语言类型。
description.en:
The language of the image version to update.

Valid values:

*   en: English.
*   zh: Simplified Chinese.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。

- 最大值：100
- 默认值：20
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

*   Valid values: 1 to 100
*   Default value: 20

description.zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the NextToken parameter is empty, no next page exists.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.

description.zh: 镜像升级任务的信息列表。
description.en: The IDs of the image update tasks.

description.zh: 设置镜像升级任务是否自动推送。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically push the image update task.

Valid values:

*   Running: automatically pushes the image update task.
*   Pending: does not automatically push the image update task.

title.zh: 获取镜像升级任务列表
